abstract: The Somatic Mosaicism across Human Tissues Network has established complementary benchmarks for somatic mutation detection, extended mutation analysis into underexplored genomic regions, and highlighted chromatin states as potential records of cellular history. These studies show that detection performance depends on reference representation, benchmark quality, and experimental design, requiring careful calibration when integrating technologies.
